name: ShellCore Command Remastered
summary: Tactical Retro Combat. End the Core War. Revisit your childhood in this years-in-the-making free open-source recreation of Flashbacker's ShellCore Command series, reimagined and overhauled for the modern day. As a "newborn" uninfected ShellCore, you will embark on a journey to uncover the secrets of a bizarre and hostile world.
